prompt:
Create one finished character illustration. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Wang Ping from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the frontier soldier who could barely read yet read every battle formation. Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

Style (fixed): Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

Inspiration only: plain practical armor, sun-browned skin, the warning ignored at Jieting, steadfast common sense.

World (fixed): year 2190, the Shu frontier colony on a jade-green moon: terraced garden cities under vast glass domes, a ringed gas giant filling the sky, an orbital elevator climbing into space, starship docks glowing green. Her costume, weapon and setting belong to this world.

Weapon (fixed — ours): a plain iron spear, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour and no wood, silk tassels or forged-bronze fittings.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): black hair fading to crimson at the tips. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Skin tone (fixed — ours): light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone. Keep exactly this skin tone.

Costume colours (ours): jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Rank (fixed): she is a famed war general — her costume must read battlefield might at first glance: imposing, richly worked armour and cloth with flagship-card detail, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Costume silhouette selected: 2, heavy assault bulk with broad thick shoulder and leg armor, large back and calf thrusters, fitted torso and narrow waist. Build armor as interlocking wedge bastions with staggered banks of jade panels forming a physical tactical formation around the chest and hips. White-jade alloy, imperial gold trim, earthen-brown ceramic inserts, green emitters and panel lines. Deep open chest window with natural cleavage, bare shoulders and upper arms, all other regions thick hard-surface plates; no cloth. Small soft square-oval face with rounded jaw, clear teal eyes, strong neat brows, calm determined closed lips. Black hair fading to crimson tips in a high short spiky ponytail with side-shaved temple. Stand planted facing viewer on empty orbital dock overlooking domed jade-moon garden terraces, ringed gas giant behind. Right hand holds one full straight high-tech alloy spear with green plasma head, left hand open at side. Both hands and boots visible.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers. No readable text, logo or watermark.
